title: Tulip Tech Extends Autonomous Drone Missions with Lithium Metal Technology
text:
Tulip Tech has partnered with Tective to enhance the performance of the fully autonomous ReFly drone by integrating Tulip Tech’s advanced Lithium Metal battery technology. With Tulip Tech’s Lithium Metal batteries, the ReFly now achieves up to 75 minutes of continuous flight time and a return flight range exceeding 25 kilometers. This upgrade extends flight time from 35 minutes, which is more than a 100% increase, providing significantly greater operational reach for complex surveillance tasks. Read more.
